<section class="research-section home-about" id="about">
  <p class="eyebrow">ABOUT ME</p>
  <h2>Background and research interests</h2>
  <p>I am completing a Professional Science Master’s in Ecosystem Science &amp; Sustainability (Carbon Management) at Colorado State University, while pursuing an M.S. in Population, Resources &amp; Environmental Economics at Shandong University, China. I earned a B.A. in Economics from China University of Geosciences (Wuhan).</p>
  <p>My experience includes environmental assessment, ecosystem modeling, geospatial analysis, and quantitative economic analysis. I have applied methods such as life cycle assessment and life cycle costing, panel-data econometrics, evolutionary game modeling, and agricultural input–output analysis. I am interested in the economic feasibility and environmental trade-offs of agricultural and land-management decisions across different landscapes.</p>
</section>

<script>
(() => {
  const button = document.querySelector('[data-copy-email]');
  if (!button) return;
  const status = document.querySelector('.contact-status');
  button.addEventListener('click', async () => {
    const address = button.dataset.copyEmail;
    let copied = false;
    try {
      if (navigator.clipboard && window.isSecureContext) {
        await navigator.clipboard.writeText(address);
        copied = true;
      }
    } catch (_) {}
    if (!copied) {
      const field = document.createElement('textarea');
      field.value = address;
      field.setAttribute('readonly', '');
      field.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;left:-9999px;top:0';
      document.body.appendChild(field);
      field.select();
      try { copied = document.execCommand('copy'); } catch (_) {}
      field.remove();
      button.focus();
    }
    button.textContent = copied ? 'Copied!' : 'Copy email';
    status.textContent = copied ? 'Email address copied.' : 'Please select and copy the email address.';
  });
})();
</script>
